importHelp: Choose the dataset.jsonl file from a dataset export as original evidence first. Import verifies its checksum and preserves that file, the selected fields, original values and exclusion reasons.
heading: Export dataset
excluded: Include excluded observations and their reasons
contents: The ZIP contains the table, exact typed data and a manifest with the selected schema and sources.
formula: Spreadsheet fields use the retained result values. Potential formulas are escaped. Original spellings and missing-value meanings are preserved in the typed file.
invalidRange: Enter a valid first and last position within this dataset.
unavailable: The prepared files are unavailable here. Open the dataset to prepare a new export.
discarded: The prepared export files have been removed.
